evidence_sources.boundary: Authenticated empty-Canvas zoom and disclosure evidence captured on 2026-07-20. The three nominal viewport PNGs are outer-window captures whose actual content pixels differ from the target CSS viewport and therefore do not close exact viewport evidence.

Read-only public role/name/state and named-control geometry at a 1662x1138 CSS viewport; no private classes, source, network, storage, paid action, or mutating action were inspected. No screenshot file was produced by the extension path argument in this observation window.

Authenticated empty Canvas, direct official guide, and guide-published read-only populated share. Exact empty 200% is verified; the public share ignores direct numeric 200 editing and deterministically reaches 207% as its nearest high-zoom state. Focus restoration and controller-observed motion upper bounds are recorded without claiming CSS duration.
Revid behavior is paired with official observations through action-trace-mapping-2026-07-20.json and the deterministic structural comparison contract.
